observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 1300D' clearly visible on the top right. The lens has a 'Canon' logo and focus distance markings (18-24, 35, 55). The lens cap is on and has 'Canon' printed on it.

Photo 1 shows the top and front of the camera, with the mode dial, shutter button, and hot shoe visible. The lens barrel has 'Canon' and focal length markings. The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust on the body and lens.
No screen, battery, charger, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims the camera is 'as clean and New like a new one from the Box' and 'not used for...'.

claims.claim: This Canon EOS 1300D DSLR Camera is as clean and New like a new one from the Box it was not used for...
claims.evidence: Photos show minor scuffs and dust on the camera body and lens, contradicting 'new like a new one from the Box'. No proof of original packaging or full condition.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly (e.g., shutter, sensor, screen)
risks.proof: Video or photo of the camera powering on, showing the LCD screen and menu navigation.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially at the front and rear, under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential fungus or damage

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing them working.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., shutter failure, mirror lock-up)
risks.proof: Video of the camera taking a photo and showing the shutter count or a test shot.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and showing the LCD screen and menu navigation.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for fungus or scratches.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Video of the camera taking a photo and showing the shutter count or a test shot.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
